title: Identity After Authenticity: Abigail Thorn's Profile
summary: A philosophy lecture by Professor Moeller on the philosophy of identity. It builds on a discussion of Abigail Thorn's video and covers authenticity, sincerity and how online profiles reshape identity.
why: Cited in threads on social media and online identity as a framework of sincerity, authenticity and profilicity.

quote.text: it is interesting to see some meta perspective on identity creation
